acceptance: Non-required experimental workflows have a job concurrency cap or separate runner pool; required PR checks are not queued behind them.
description: On 2026-10-31 a throwaway 'release UAT dry run' (run 41163626947, branch ci/release-uat-dryrun) held about 15 parallel jobs for hours while 100+ required CI, oracle-verdict and oracle-gate runs queued; PR CI waited 1-4 hours. Experimental workflows need a concurrency cap (max-parallel, a separate runner group, or off-hours scheduling) so required checks keep runners.
